Looking at this question about Metal Gear Solid, I need to identify Solid Snake's twin brother.

In the Metal Gear Solid series lore, Solid Snake and Liquid Snake are twin brothers, both clones created from Big Boss's DNA as part of the Les Enfants Terribles project. Liquid Snake is the main antagonist of the first Metal Gear Solid game and is explicitly established as Solid Snake's twin brother.

Solidus Snake, mentioned by Agent 1, is actually their "brother" in the sense that he's also a clone of Big Boss, but he is NOT a twin - he was created separately and is described as a "perfect clone" rather than one of the twins.

The overwhelming consensus from the other agents (3 out of 4) correctly identifies Liquid Snake, and this aligns with the established canon of the game series.

Answer: Liquid Snake
